links.comparator_used: Original, unmodified AUA endourology patient education materials (21 documents)
links.outcome: Readability grade level and reading ease across six indices (FKGL, SMOG, GFI, CLI, ARI, FRE)
links.effect: Original PEMs were at about the 9th to 11th grade level; ChatGPT-4o-modified versions were at the 4th to 6th grade level (p < 0.001 for all comparisons). Variability across readability scores was also reduced.
links.quote: Unmodified PEMs were written at approximately the ninth to 11<sup>th</sup> grade level, whereas AI-modified versions were reduced to the fourth to sixth grade range (p < 0.001 for all comparisons).
